resend.title: Email delivery (Resend)
resend.subtitle: Connect a Resend account to send transactional emails — password resets, invitations, and verification codes.
resend.apiKeyHint: Generate at resend.com → API Keys. The key is encrypted at rest and never returned in full.
resend.fromAddressHint: Must use a domain you've verified in your Resend dashboard.
resend.notConfiguredHint: Email is currently disabled. Save a Resend key and From address to start delivering.
resend.saveError: Could not save the configuration. Check the values and try again.
resend.testSubtitle: Confirm SPF/DKIM setup by dispatching a one-off message to an address you control.
resend.testRecipientHint: Use a real address you can check — the message arrives in seconds.
resend.testError: Could not send the test message. Resend rejected the request.
resend.testNeedsConfigured: Save the API key and From address above first.

validation.apiKeyMin: Resend API key must be at least 20 characters
validation.apiKeyCharset: Only alphanumeric, underscore and dash characters are allowed
validation.fromAddress: From address must be a valid email
validation.replyTo: Reply-To must be a valid email

diagnostics.title: Runtime environment
diagnostics.subtitle: Env-driven values that gate the mail pipeline. Set these on the identity service.
diagnostics.masterKey: AES-256-GCM master key used to encrypt platform_settings secrets at rest. Required — service refuses to start without it.
diagnostics.masterKeyNote: This is the only env var that must stay out of the UI: rotating the master key would invalidate every encrypted API key in the DB.
diagnostics.publicUrl: Public origin used to deep-link reset/invite URLs inside emails.
diagnostics.fromAddress: Default From address when the admin has not configured one in this page.
diagnostics.supportEmail: Shown in the footer of every transactional email.

system.title: System environment
system.subtitle: Public URLs, support contact, default locale, and default From address. These values override the same env vars on the identity service — no restart needed.
system.saveSuccess: System configuration updated. The next email will use the new values.
system.saveError: Could not save system configuration. Check the values and try again.

hints.appPublicBaseUrl: Used to deep-link reset and invite URLs inside emails (e.g. https://app.philandz.com).
hints.supportEmail: Shown in the footer of every transactional email.
hints.defaultLocale: Locale prefix for the reset/invite deep links (e.g. en, vi, en-US).
hints.mailFromAddress: Sender when the mail provider has no per-mailbox From configured (e.g. Philandz ‹noreply@yourdomain.com›).

validation.urlProtocol: URL must start with http:// or https://
validation.localeFormat: Use 1-10 lowercase letters, digits or dashes
